# Roadmap

Epics = GitHub milestones; stories = issues. State and priority reflect GitHub as
of 2026-06-12. Links: `https://github.com/birnio/birnio/issues/<n>`.

## M0 — Workspace Foundation
> Foundational workspace, documentation, developer workflow, and architectural setup.

| Story | Priority |
|-------|----------|
| #45 [chore] Add LICENSE files (MIT OR Apache-2.0) | p1 |
| #6 [docs] Add contributor setup guide | p2 |
| #15 [ci] Skip Rust checks when Rust files are unchanged | p2 |
| #10 [ci] Pin Homebrew cask versions and checksums in release flow | p2 |

## M1 — First Request Execution
> Send a request from the GTK UI and render the response end-to-end.

| Story | Priority |
|-------|----------|
| #2 [http] Support request body and headers end-to-end | p1 |
| #46 [http] Make timeout and redirect policy configurable | p3 |

## M2 — Collections and Persistence
> Persist collections and requests as grep-friendly HAR workspace files.

| #41 [core] Implement variable interpolation for requests | p1 |
| #42 [storage] Define environment persistence in HAR workspace | p1 |
| #43 [storage] Retire SQLite persistence in favor of HAR workspace | p2 |
| #23 [docs] Document HAR workspace format | p2 |

## M6 — Secrets and Secure Storage
> Safe handling for tokens, passwords, and sensitive environment values.

| Story | Priority |
|-------|----------|
| #31 [security] Design secret storage strategy | p1 |
| #32 [core] Model secret references separately from plain variables | p1 |
| #34 [docs] Document security model and HAR limitations | p2 |

---

> **Dependency note:** the roadmap reveals an architectural turn — from M2 onward,
> persistence migrates from SQLite to **HAR workspace files** (see
> [MADR.md](MADR.md) ADR-0006). M1 still uses the current engine; M2/M3 rewrite the
> storage layer; M4 wires the UI to that new foundation.
